ambiguity_note_adjudications.ambiguity_note: "Fall under the PR_156018 prefix" is looser than "begins with", but it is applied to pull request IDs, so it reads as an identifier-prefix scope rather than repository membership.
The date is attached to comments "made on" the issue, which reads as the commenting event on the Issue rather than the comment-to-Actor relation; ownership is implied rather than stated outright.
"Authored" stands in for the OPENED_BY relation of the comment; the date is attached to comments "posted to" the issue, i.e. the commenting event.
"Created" stands in for the OPENED_BY relation of the comment; time ownership is stated explicitly.
"Link domain" does not spell out the registrable (eTLD+1) granularity, but it still identifies the domain field of the link.
"Domain" does not spell out the registrable (eTLD+1) granularity; "total number of links" keeps link-level counting.
"The 50 most recent commit references" expresses descending reference-time ordering plus limit 50, not a time-window filter.
"Attached to reviews" stands in for COMMENTED_ON_REVIEW; the meaning stays unambiguous.
The absence of a date restriction on the Actor branch is implicit (the date is stated only for the external links) rather than explicit.
"Share a coupling relationship with" is direction-neutral phrasing; R_156018 remains the anchored repository and the other repositories are the returned targets.

"One entry per resolving pull request" could be read as implying per-PR de-duplication, which the card does not request; read as a description of row shape, it is consistent. "Timeline" adds no time filter.
